## 🇺🇸 English

### About

- I build **back-end systems in C# / .NET** — business rules, REST APIs and desktop applications — and I write the tests before the code.
- Core stack: **C#, .NET 8/10, Java, Python, PHP, SQL, REST APIs**, with HTML/CSS/JS and PySide6 on the client side.
- My differentiator is **software quality**: TDD with xUnit, Conventional Commits, CI pipelines and formal test plans (equivalence partitioning and boundary-value analysis).
- Computer Science undergrad (4/8) and Industrial Automation technician. Currently an apprentice at **GE Vernova**. Looking for my first formal role as a **Junior Back-end Developer**.

### How I work

| Practice | Evidence |
|---|---|
| **Test-Driven Development** | 56 `[Fact]`/`[Theory]` cases in C# + 11 `pytest` cases — 67 total across 7 repositories |
| **CI/CD** | GitHub Actions pipeline (`restore → build → dotnet test`) on `fintech-bank-xunit` |
| **Test design** | Documented test plan with equivalence classes and boundary values |
| **Commit discipline** | Conventional Commits with explanatory bodies |
| **Code standards** | `.editorconfig`, layered solution structure, isolated business rules (no I/O in domain logic) |

### Featured Projects

**🗳️ [SistemaEleicao](https://github.com/PedroHenriqueM2005/SistemaEleicao)** — `C#` `.NET 8` `xUnit` `TDD`
Election system handling candidate registration, voter eligibility, blank/null ballots and result tallying with tie detection. Built strictly test-first — **23 test cases** across three suites (`CandidatoTests`, `VotacaoTests`, `ApuracaoTests`) drove every business rule in `EleicaoManager`.

**🏦 [fintech-bank-xunit](https://github.com/PedroHenriqueM2005/fintech-bank-xunit)** — `C#` `.NET 10` `GitHub Actions` `xUnit`
Core of a simplified digital bank (checking account and loan services). Domain logic is isolated in pure service classes with no I/O, so **17 parameterized tests** run in milliseconds. Includes a CI pipeline and a written test plan using equivalence partitioning and boundary values.

**📄 [SignDocs](https://github.com/PedroHenriqueM2005/SignDocs)** — `Python` `PySide6` `pytest`
Desktop document manager that opens and renders PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, TXT and images in a single interface, replacing "one app per file format". **11 pytest cases** cover the document loader, database manager and file utilities.

**🛒 [ecommerce-checkout-xunit](https://github.com/PedroHenriqueM2005/ecommerce-checkout-xunit)** — `C#` `.NET 10` `xUnit`
Checkout rules engine: coupon validation, shipping calculation, loyalty points and tracking-code generation. Each edge case (invalid coupon, zero-value cart, region casing) is asserted in its own test.

### Projetos em Destaque

**🗳️ [SistemaEleicao](https://github.com/PedroHenriqueM2005/SistemaEleicao)** — `C#` `.NET 8` `xUnit` `TDD`
Sistema de eleição com cadastro de candidatos, elegibilidade de eleitores, votos em branco/nulos e apuração com detecção de empate. Construído estritamente test-first — **23 casos de teste** em três suítes (`CandidatoTests`, `VotacaoTests`, `ApuracaoTests`) guiaram cada regra de negócio do `EleicaoManager`.

**🏦 [fintech-bank-xunit](https://github.com/PedroHenriqueM2005/fintech-bank-xunit)** — `C#` `.NET 10` `GitHub Actions` `xUnit`
Núcleo de um banco digital simplificado (conta corrente e empréstimo). As regras de domínio ficam isoladas em classes de serviço puras, sem I/O, o que permite rodar **17 testes parametrizados** em milissegundos. Inclui pipeline de CI e plano de testes escrito com classes de equivalência e valores de fronteira.

**📄 [SignDocs](https://github.com/PedroHenriqueM2005/SignDocs)** — `Python` `PySide6` `pytest`
Gerenciador de documentos desktop que abre e renderiza PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, TXT e imagens em uma única interface, eliminando "um aplicativo para cada formato". **11 casos pytest** cobrem o carregador de documentos, o gerenciador de banco e os utilitários de arquivo.

**🛒 [ecommerce-checkout-xunit](https://github.com/PedroHenriqueM2005/ecommerce-checkout-xunit)** — `C#` `.NET 10` `xUnit`
Motor de regras de checkout: validação de cupons, cálculo de frete, pontos de fidelidade e geração de código de rastreio. Cada caso extremo (cupom inválido, carrinho zerado, diferença entre maiúsculas e minúsculas na região) é validado em teste próprio.
